Molte aziende hanno provato l’AI generat: Many companies have tried generative AI. Few have brought it into everyday work. As an AI Product Manager, that’s the step I work on: choosing the right problem, building a prototype people can try, measuring whether it works and making sure people use it.

Dove porto l’AI in un’azienda: Where I bring AI into a company
Parto da processi e persone, non dagli s: I start from processes and people, not tools. I map the activities, estimate value and risk, and choose one or two cases to start from, with success criteria written down before we begin.
Con Claude Design e Claude Code costruis: With Claude Design and Claude Code I build working prototypes for real users to try. Decisions are made on something you can touch, not on a slide.
Risposte con le fonti, soglie di confide: Answers with sources, confidence thresholds, human review, automated tests on the outputs. The requirements of the EU AI Act, ISO 42001 and NIST AI RMF become concrete controls.
Formazione sul lavoro vero, colleghi cha: Training on real work, champion colleagues, adoption KPIs collected without monitoring people. This is where many AI projects stall.
Un progetto AI è un progetto di dati. Pe: An AI project is a data project. That’s why I follow CPMAI, the Project Management Institute’s method: iterative, with a checkpoint at the end of each phase.
<span class=\"r-n\">I</span><b class=\"r: IBusiness understandingWhich problem, for whom, and how we’ll measure success. If AI isn’t the right answer, we say so here.
<span class=\"r-n\">II</span><b class=\": IIData understandingWhich data exist, where they are, who owns them and how reliable they are.
<span class=\"r-n\">III</span><b class=\: IIIData preparationCleaning, permissions and privacy before any model.
<span class=\"r-n\">IV</span><b class=\": IVModel developmentA prototype built with AI agents, tried by users within days.
<span class=\"r-n\">V</span><b class=\"r: VEvaluationAutomated tests on the outputs, edge cases, checking the criteria agreed at the start.
<span class=\"r-n\">VI</span><b class=\": VIOperationalisationRelease, training, adoption KPIs and monitoring over time.

Cosa fa un consulente di intelligenza ar: What does an artificial intelligence consultant do for a company?
Aiuta a scegliere dove l’AI crea valore,: They help choose where AI creates value, build and validate solutions, manage risk and compliance, and get people to actually use them. Unlike a software vendor, they don’t sell a tool: they start from the problem and the data.
Da dove si comincia a introdurre l’intel: Where do you start when introducing artificial intelligence in a company?
Da un inventario: quali strumenti AI le: With an inventory: which AI tools people already use, often with personal accounts, and which repetitive tasks weigh the most. Then one or two small use cases, with a measurable success criterion and a prototype tested within a few weeks.
Perché tanti progetti di AI si fermano d: Why do so many AI projects stop after the demo?
Because technology is the easy part. What’s often missing is success criteria agreed in advance, reliable data, users’ trust and someone who follows adoption after the release. That’s why I measure real usage with dedicated KPIs.
L’AI Act obbliga le aziende a formare i: Does the AI Act require companies to train their employees?
Sì. Dal 2 febbraio 2025 l’articolo 4 del: Yes. Since 2 February 2025, Article 4 of the AI Act requires providers and deployers of AI systems to ensure a sufficient level of AI literacy among the staff who use them. It doesn’t prescribe a standard course: training must be adapted to the roles and the systems used. See the workshops.
È la certificazione del Project Manageme: It’s the Project Management Institute’s certification for managing artificial intelligence projects with an iterative six-phase method, from business understanding to operationalisation, with a focus on data and trustworthy AI.

The “AI for product and project managers” format is designed for people who manage projects and products: it uses AI for discovery, specifications, analysis and tickets, and teaches what to delegate to an agent and what to check. La formazione sull’AI Act è obbligatoria: Is AI Act training mandatory for all companies?
L’articolo 4 dell’AI Act, in vigore dal: Article 4 of the AI Act, in force since 2 February 2025, applies to providers of AI systems and to those who use them professionally. In practice it affects almost every company whose employees use tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot or Claude for work. The rule requires a sufficient level of literacy, adapted to roles.
Meglio un corso online o un workshop in: Is an online course or an in-company workshop better?
Un corso online va bene per le basi. Un: An online course is fine for the basics. An in-company workshop is useful when the goal is to apply AI to your own processes: you work on real cases, with your own rules on data and tools, and the team leaves with a concrete result.
Che differenza c’è tra un corso sui prom: What’s the difference between a prompting course and an adoption workshop?
Un corso sui prompt insegna a usare uno: A prompting course teaches you to use a tool. An adoption workshop works on what changes in the team’s work: which tasks to hand over to AI, how to check the results, how to measure whether the tool is really being used.

Cosa fa davvero, come si paga, cosa ci f: What it really does, how you pay for it, what I use it for every day and when it isn’t worth it.
<b>In breve.</b> Claude Code è l’assiste: In short. Claude Code is Anthropic’s assistant that works directly on a project’s files: it reads a folder, proposes a plan, edits the files and runs commands, asking for confirmation before important actions. You pay for it with a Claude subscription or through the API. It makes sense even for people who don’t code, if they have a concrete project and the time to check the work.
Cos’è Claude Code, in parole semplici?: What is Claude Code, in plain words?
È Claude, il modello di Anthropic, messo: It’s Claude, Anthropic’s model, put to work inside a folder instead of inside a chat. You tell it in plain language what you want to achieve. It reads the files that are there, tells you how it plans to proceed, changes what’s needed and shows you the before and after. If a command needs running, such as publishing a site or running a check, it does that too.
La chat ti dà una risposta da copiare. C: The chat gives you an answer to copy. Claude Code does the work, and you review it.
Lo apri in una cartella del computer e g: You open it in a folder on your computer and write to it
Quando lavoro su file che stanno solo su: When I work on files that live only on my PC
Stessa cosa, con un’interfaccia a finest: The same thing, with a windowed interface
Per chi non vuole usare il terminale: For people who don’t want to use the terminal
Lavora in un ambiente nel cloud collegat: It works in a cloud environment connected to a GitHub repository
Per i siti: ogni modifica approvata va o: For websites: every approved change goes live by itself
Un’istruzione che parte a un orario fiss: An instruction that starts at a fixed time
Ogni mattina, per il calendario dei cont: Every morning, for my sites’ content calendar
Quanto costa Claude Code?: How much does Claude Code cost?
Ci sono due modi di pagarlo:: There are two ways to pay for it:
<b>Abbonamento Claude.</b> Claude Code è: Claude subscription. Claude Code is included in Claude’s paid plans, with usage limits that grow with the plan.
<b>API di Anthropic.</b> Paghi a consumo: Anthropic API. You pay per use, based on how much text Claude reads and writes. It makes sense for companies or automated uses.
Non scrivo cifre qui perché piani e prez: I don’t give figures here because plans and prices change often: the current ones are at https://claude.com/pricing. The individual plan is enough to start; if you use it every day across several projects, the limits become the thing to watch.
Per chi ha senso se non sei uno sviluppa: Who does it make sense for if you’re not a developer?
Prototipi veri al posto dei mockup, e un: Real prototypes instead of mockups, and a concrete way to understand what to ask the team for
Chi ha un sito o un piccolo e-commerce s: People with a website or a small static e-commerce site
Testi, pagine nuove e controlli SEO senz: Copy, new pages and SEO checks without waiting for someone
Chi gestisce dati in fogli e file: People who manage data in spreadsheets and files
Script che riordinano o controllano file: Scripts that tidy up or check repetitive files; the data must always be verified
Chi vuole un’app complessa da vendere: People who want a complex app to sell
Un prototipo sì; sicurezza, pagamenti e: A prototype, yes; security, payments and maintenance need a developer
Chi cerca solo risposte o testi: People who only want answers or copy
Cosa ci ho costruito io?: What have I built with it?
Non scrivo codice a mano, eppure con Cla: I don’t write code by hand, yet today with Claude Code I run:
<b>Questo sito.</b> Pagine HTML su GitHu: This site. HTML pages on GitHub, published automatically to Firebase with every change. The full story is in How I built my site with Claude Code.
<b>I siti dei miei affitti</b> e quello: The sites for my rentals and the one for Staged.ai, with guides and articles that come out on a schedule.
<b>Una pagina di regia</b> che mette ins: A control page that brings together the sites’ Search Console, Analytics and Cloudflare data and decides what to publish. Every morning a Claude Code routine reads it and does the day’s work.
La parte che conta non è il codice. Sono: The part that matters isn’t the code. It’s well-written instructions: what it can do, what it mustn’t touch, how to check that the result is right.
Cosa non fa, o fa male?: What doesn’t it do, or do badly?
<b>Non conosce i tuoi dati se non glieli: It doesn’t know your data unless you give it. If a number isn’t in the files, it may write a plausible one. I always check the numbers myself.
<b>Non sostituisce il giudizio.</b> Fa q: It doesn’t replace judgement. It does what you ask, even when it’s a bad idea. Asking it for a plan first helps you stop in time.
<b>Non è magia sui progetti grandi.</b>: It isn’t magic on large projects. The bigger the project and the fewer the rules, the more time you spend correcting.
<b>Va tenuto lontano dai segreti.</b> Pa: Keep it away from secrets. Passwords and keys don’t belong in the folders you let it read or in repositories.
Come inizio, in pratica?: How do I start, in practice?
Scegli un progetto piccolo e reale: una: Pick a small, real project: a page, a file to tidy up, a check you do by hand every week.

Chiedi prima il piano, poi le modifiche,: Ask for the plan first, then the changes, and look at what changed before you approve.
Quando funziona, collegalo a GitHub: ogn: When it works, connect it to GitHub: every change becomes traceable and reversible.
Se vuoi portare questo modo di lavorare: If you want to bring this way of working into a team, I write about it in The method and in Learning AI at work.

La chat risponde e ti dà testi o codice: The chat answers and gives you text or code to copy. Claude Code works inside a folder: it reads the files, edits them, runs commands and shows you what it changed. It’s the difference between advice and a colleague who does the work in front of you.
Serve saper programmare per usare Claude: Do you need to know how to code to use Claude Code?
Per progetti piccoli, come un sito stati: For small projects, such as a static site or a script for your own files, no. You do need to describe clearly what you want and check the result: Claude Code asks for confirmation before the actions that matter, and the decision stays yours.

Un corso online va bene per le basi. Un: An online course is fine for the basics. An in-company workshop is useful when the goal is to apply AI to the company’s processes: you work on real cases, with the internal rules on data and tools, and the team leaves with a concrete result.
